context: Run a small decision review against the existing result-aware semantic chart contract and the textcharts dependency boundary. Do not modify runtime registration or packaging in this item.
description: Make an explicit product, security, and support decision before any BenchBox distribution or server configuration begins bundling or proxying the external textcharts-mcp server. Compare separate-client configuration, opt-in bundled deployment, and server-side proxying; assess namespace collisions, tenant isolation, raw renderer input limits, package/licensing/support ownership, sessionless HTTP behavior, and rollback. Record the accepted/rejected option in an ADR or contract document, define acceptance tests and release/support consequences, and open implementation work only after approval.
